about_the_game:
A mini DLC containing two Bookmarks that affect Kuroda42’s growth.

Stasis Bookmark

A mysterious bookmark that can stop Kuroda42’s growth and departure.

Keep your favorite form just the way it is.

Flux Bookmark

A mysterious bookmark that randomizes Kuroda42’s next growth path.

It opens up more chances to meet many different Kuroda42 forms.

Both have no usage limits and can be toggled anytime from the Kuroda42 details screen.

Enjoy an even better co-living life with Kuroda42!

short_description: gogh: Focus with Your Avatar is a multiplayer online focus game for work. Customize your ideal workspace and cute avatars, gather in each other’s rooms, and focus together. Timers and To-Dos, lo-fi music, and beautiful ambience make desk work more fun!
